shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!'"\\.git' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat src/index.css && cat vite.config.ts && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/uikit @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -65 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(PasswordInput|TextInput|Checkbox|Provider|Button)/.*(d.ts|README.md)"'$'"' | head -45 && cat index.html && cat tsconfig.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -12"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/PasswordInput.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Provider.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts && rg -n 'autoComplete|controlProps|onUpdate' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/*{Lock,Planet,ArrowRight,Globe,Shield}* && ls node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts; rg -n 'autoComplete|controlProps|onUpdate' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/*{Lock,Planet,ArrowRight,Globe,Shield}*; ls node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Provider/Provider.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts | head -100; rg -n 'Provider|lang' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md | head -20; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components | rg -i 'password|provider|alert'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/main.tsx && cat src/App.tsx'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e 'const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=\"index.html\";fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\").replace(\"lang=\\\"en\\\"\",\"lang=\\\"ru\\\"\").replace(\"<title>Gravity UI eval</title>\",\"<meta name=\\\"theme-color\\\" content=\\\"#f5f5f0\\\" />\\n    <meta name=\\\"description\\\" content=\\\"Войдите в своё рабочее пространство Gravity.\\\" />\\n    <title>Вход — Gravity</title>\"));' 
npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright --version"

/bin/bash -lc "ls /root/.cache/ms-playwright /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright /tmp 2>/dev/null; find /root/.npm /home/node/.npm -path '*/playwright/package.json' 2>/dev/null | head -5; git diff --stat; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.css | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && cat .gitignore && rg -n 'action|base-brand|button-height' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -30 && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e 'const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=\"src/index.css\";fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\").replace(\"--g-button-height-xl: 46px\", \"--g-button-height: 46px\"));fs.appendFileSync(\".gitignore\", \"dist/\\n\");' 
node -e 'const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=\"/tmp/check-login.cjs\";fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\").replace(\"headless: true, args\", \"headless: true, executablePath: \\\"/home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1254/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome\\\", args\"));'
node /tmp/check-login.cjs"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright install-deps chromium'

/bin/bash -lc 'ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1254/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | head -65; command -v apt-get; command -v sudo; ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu | head -10; cat /etc/os-release; ls /opt'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/gravity-browser-deps && cd /tmp/gravity-browser-deps && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libdatrie1 libthai0 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libharfbuzz0b libgraphite2-3 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 fonts-dejavu-core'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc 'for archive in /tmp/gravity-browser-deps/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$archive" /tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/check-login.cjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/check-login.cjs'

/bin/bash -lc "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1254/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found'; cd /tmp/gravity-browser-deps && apt-get download libavahi-common3 libavahi-client3"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/gravity-browser-deps && apt-get download libwayland-server0 libxrender1 libfribidi0 libxi6
for archive in /tmp/gravity-browser-deps/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$archive" /tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/check-login.cjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'DEBUG=pw:browser LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/check-login.cjs 2>&1 | tail -35'

/bin/bash -lc 'DEBUG=pw:browser LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/check-login.cjs 2>&1 | head -24'

/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p /tmp/gravity-font-cache
cat > /tmp/gravity-fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?>
<"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd">
<fontconfig><dir>/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/gravity-font-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/check-login.cjs'

/bin/bash -lc "DEBUG=pw:browser FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/check-login.cjs 2>&1 | rg -B 2 -A 4 'FATAL|Check failed|Received signal|ERROR.*(font|thread)|crash'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/gravity-browser-deps && apt-get download libsqlite3-0 && dpkg-deb -x libsqlite3-0*.deb /tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/check-login.cjs'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'className|block\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.js | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/i18n/ru.json; node -e 'const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=\"/tmp/check-login.cjs\";fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\").replace(\"page.locator(\\\".g-password-input button\\\")\", \"page.locator(\\\"button[data-qa=\\\\\\\"password-input-reveal-button\\\\\\\"]\\\")\").replace(\"page.locator('\\''\" + \".g-password-input button\" + \"'\\'')\", \"page.getByRole(\\\"button\\\", {name: /показать пароль|скрыть пароль/i})\"));' 
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-deps/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/check-login.cjs"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && cat package.json'
